title: Ehrhard's inequality for convex sets
description: A complete proof of Ehrhard's inequality for closed convex sets: Phi^{-1} of the Gaussian measure of lambda K + (1 - lambda) L is at least lambda Phi^{-1}(gamma(K)) + (1 - lambda) Phi^{-1}(gamma(L)). Gaussian heat semigroups, the heat equation and a moving function under the semigroup; the sharp gradient bound |grad Q_t f| <= t^(-1/2) I(Q_t f) from a rearrangement inequality; the interpolation method of Neeman and Paouris with the heat semigroup: a quantity monotone along the flow of a pair of correlated Gaussian vectors; Lipschitz approximation of convex sets. Concavity along translates of a convex set follows.

measure and integration as in Fremlin's Measure Theory (core course Measure and Integration), cited by number: 123A, 123C, 123D, 252B, 263A
